title: Every newsroom vault is now a pack vault, which the browser's vault UI cannot open: take the vault views off the sites
note: The editor, 27 October 2026: all vaults are now pack mode only, so the vault views go. The 'Open the vault in the browser' links send readers to dev.vault.sgraph.ai, which cannot open a pack vault. They all come from the press's build/build.py: vault_open_url (line 2990) and its uses at lines 2353 (the evidence vault page, team /admin/vault/), 2481, 2999, 3007 and 3057 (the vaults page and the source watch, refs /vaults/ and /vaults/source-watch/, its screenshot linked to the UI). The CSP's frame-src dev.vault.sgraph.ai (build/csp.py line 30) is on every page and goes with them. Also stale: refs /vaults/ says two vaults 'are public and open read-only in your browser'; team /admin/vault/ shows the retired 3ytzxm3g at 1dceaa1dfa7f with its read key. The read key was published on purpose, so it is no leak, but it is the wrong vault. Ask: drop the browser-open links, the frame-src and the screenshots. Keep each vault's id, mode, head and counts, and say how a reader can clone one with sgit (a read key and `sgit clone`), or that it is private. Story-site for the words. Not in scope: assets/vault/newsroom-vault.js as used by the Ask pane and the phone app (/now/) opens the reader's own vault, not the newsroom's; whether readers' vaults move to pack mode too is a question for the editor. Press change, so security's review. | Done by dev in press 8a5a945 (05:49 UTC, the editor's word in dev's session): /admin/vault/ and /vaults/ no longer show any vault or read key. It went to press dev directly, not through security's review; security's 22:35 pass can review it.
